description: This file defines the SocksInterceptor class, which manages SOCKS proxy handling, message interception, and event handling for SOCKS support within a WebSocket transport context in the Playwright core project.

classes.name: SocksInterceptor
classes.description: Manages SOCKS proxy interactions, message interception, and event forwarding for SOCKS support in the Playwright core server.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SocksInterceptor with transport, pattern, and redirect port, setting up event handlers and proxy for SOCKS support.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and handlers associated with the SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: interceptMessage
methods.description: Intercepts messages to handle SOCKS support object creation, events, and data, returning true if the message was handled.
